decisions.reason: Major-severity concern that evidence confirms but does not resolve. The native sheet proves R36/R37 are DNP (symbol uuid d69380f9: value 120, in_bom no, dnp yes applied to both instances), connectivity and geometry confirm both terminators sit correctly at the two transceiver ends of /CAN2+-/CAN2-, and the README advertises internal wideband operation on CAN bus #2. Whether the all-DNP population is a deliberate builder option (the bus is also exposed on J1 pins 11/15, where internal termination would conflict with harness terminators) or an omission cannot be determined from the packet; no population/termination requirement is declared. Per adjudication rules a major concern cannot be merely noted, and inventing a termination requirement is not permitted, so it is deferred pending design-intent documentation or build instructions.
